insights.one_liner: Knowledge Values is a 27-person Amsterdam software company building knowledge and AI tools for contact centres, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A small team of about 27 people in Amsterdam, founded in 2003, mostly in engineering, IT and consulting.
Staff studied at Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, University of Amsterdam and VU Amsterdam, plus universities in India and Croatia, mostly in software and computer science.
Its stated values are work hard, work smart and work efficiently, with a strong focus on results.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Knowledge Values B.V.).
One of its two current consulting jobs in Amsterdam doesn't require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Says its 'Intelligent Service Desk' product for contact centres has won awards.
